action_space: bounded post-mode policy action residual before the authoritative environment action-to-control mapping

single_channel_result.steer: No tested perturbation extended survival; it changes attitude margins but is not a standalone pitch-failure remedy.
single_channel_result.rear_wheel_drive: At most one tick of extension; both signs can be state-dependent.
single_channel_result.hip: Positive residual can add one tick on isolated states, while negative residual generally shortens survival; it is useful only in coordinated sequences.
single_channel_result.knee: Both signs are dynamically effective, so the channel is neither dead nor sign-swapped, but isolated perturbations usually shorten survival and at best add one tick. It is a state-dependent coordinated control variable, not an independent recovery actuator.

interpretation: The action-to-state Jacobian is full rank from tick 2 onward, but highly ill-conditioned. No single small channel perturbation supplies the multi-tick gains found by CEM; recovery requires coordinated, time-structured hip/knee/drive/steer corrections.
